title: Netflix, Crunchyroll Add More Episodes for Detective Conan Anime's 3rd Collection Featuring FBI on August 1
content: The "FBI Intervention" selection began streaming on May 1 with episodes that had never before been officially released in the U.S. The selection's specific episode numbers from the overall anime are 170-171, 226-227, 258-259, 277-278, 279-280, and 307-308.
author: ANN

title: Kaylee Hottle, Young Godzilla x Kong & MonsterVerse Star, Dies at 18 After Tragic Car Accident
content: Kaylee Hottle, young star seen in Godzilla vs. Kong and Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire , has died in a tragic car accident at the age of 18. As reported by TMZ , Hottle’s father Joshua revealed that earlier this morning the young star had died in a car accident in Maryland.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling and Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint Confirm a Brand New Project in North America
content: Solo Leveling is easily the most popular and influential manhwa series of all time, paving the path for the entire medium’s success. While the manhwa and light novel were already globally famous, the anime adaptation by A-1 Pictures turned it into a global phenomenon.

title: Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya Finale TV Anime Premieres in 2027
content: After 13 years, the anime adaptation of Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya is ending. Fate/kaleid’s production committee announced that Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya Finale, a TV anime sequel to Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya: Licht Nameless Girl, will conclude the series. The anime will premiere next year.
author: Anime Corner

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Casts Momoka Terasawa, Sayumi Suzushiro
content: The official website for Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, announced two more cast members on Tuesday.

title: Akiko Higashimura's Live-Action Vacance no Hōsoku Series Reveals Main Trailer, Opening Song
content: ABEMA started streaming the full trailer for Vacance no Hōsoku ( The Vacation Rules ), a new live-action series with original concept, direction, and scripts by manga creator Akiko Higashimura ( Blank Canvas: My So-Called Artist’s Journey , Tokyo Tarareba Girls , Princess Jellyfish ), on Tuesday.

title: Live-action 2027 Kaiji Film Unveils Trailer, Teaser, Cast
content: TOHO Movies revealed on Tuesday the first full trailer, the accompanying teaser trailer, the cast, and character visuals for Kaiji : Jinsei Revenge Game ( Kaiji : Life Revenge Game), the new live-action film adaptation of Nobuyuki Fukumoto 's Kaiji manga.
